critical_boundaries.B2: Exact abstract count k^2, but no independent primary occupancy/saturation relation. Reflection blocks deterministic pointwise enumeration of all raw ordered-pair states from fixed ray cells for k>=2.
critical_boundaries.T2: Swap-orbit count k(k+1)/2 is exact but likewise uncoupled.
critical_boundaries.a_n_meaning: Exact: a_n is the cardinality of realized transverse layer-crossing events along the reflection-symmetric ray. This does not predict the crossing indices.
critical_boundaries.cyclic: Realized crossing-count meaning is cyclically reciprocal with no axis privilege.
critical_boundaries.dimension: m counts abstract level slots only; physical dimensionality is not established.
critical_boundaries.five: Square coupling gate is closed. Conditional completed/balanced controls give 4 while activated gives 9; no native answer.
critical_boundaries.gap: Balanced reflection gives a unique half-integer split for consecutive perfect-power capacities, but this allocation semantics is not independently selected.
critical_boundaries.perfect_power: k^m<=n<(k+1)^m is proved only conditional on an independent completed-capacity coupling to Bm(k). No m is selected.
